scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu at the pantry counter gripping a chai cup, Arjun leaning on the fridge chewing a protein bar, a half-eaten cake box and drooping birthday banner corner behind them
scenes.camera: slow push in on both, handheld

dialogue.line: Invoice needs to go by noon, Anu.
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs

dialogue.line: Give me till eleven, just need to check something.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

dialogue.line: Check what? We already fixed the numbers.
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs

dialogue.line: Eleven. I'm not backing out, just wait.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

scenes.micro_acting: Anu presses the drooping banner corner flat without looking, Arjun chews slow, eyes narrowing
scenes.narrative_job: Anu stalls Arjun while pressure builds

scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu alone on the stairwell, phone held low, WhatsApp mic icon pressed, waveform climbing on the screen
scenes.camera: overhead close on phone, slight handheld tremor

dialogue.line: Sir, it's me. Arjun wants me to pad his invoice.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

dialogue.line: He says he'll tell everyone about the cash if I don't.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

dialogue.line: I don't want to do this. Your call now, sir.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

scenes.micro_acting: she glances at the door, lowers her voice, releases the mic button and exhales hard
scenes.narrative_job: Anu completes the honest voice note exposing Arjun

scenes.keyframe_visual: Vikram at his desk, invoice spreadsheet glowing on the monitor, phone buzzing beside the face-down photo frame
scenes.camera: slow dolly in through the glass wall

dialogue.line: I flagged his numbers three days ago. This is a second sign, not proof.
dialogue.voice: middle-aged Indian man, low measured baritone, precise English, long pauses

dialogue.line: Nothing goes to HR until finance audits every invoice. Quietly.
dialogue.voice: middle-aged Indian man, low measured baritone, precise English, long pauses

scenes.micro_acting: he taps the spreadsheet cell twice, jaw tightens, hand rests on the desk phone without lifting it
scenes.narrative_job: reveal Vikram's prior suspicion; quiet audit ordered, no HR yet

scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu standing at the open cabin door, ID lanyard swipe beeping behind her, Arjun visible through the glass hunched over his laptop, unaware
scenes.camera: handheld, slight arc from Anu to the glass background

dialogue.line: Until finance finishes, say nothing to Arjun. If he pushes, you call me before you answer him.
dialogue.voice: middle-aged Indian man, low measured baritone, precise English, long pauses
young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

scenes.micro_acting: Anu's eyes flick to Arjun through the glass, her hand tightens on the tote strap
scenes.narrative_job: plant - Anu now works for Vikram's decisions

scenes.keyframe_visual: Priya at her desk on the normal office floor, afternoon light, Arjun visible at his own desk in the background unaware, Anu standing near the cabin door
scenes.camera: static close, rack focus from Arjun to Priya's face

dialogue.line: Finance starts auditing Arjun's invoices tomorrow. What did you tell Vikram sir?
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

dialogue.line: Nothing, Priya. I don't know why.
dialogue.voice: young Indian woman, early 20s, quick Mumbai English, slightly breathless when nervous

scenes.micro_acting: Priya's thumb stops mid-scroll on the trackpad, her eyes stay fixed on Anu
scenes.narrative_job: cliffhanger - Priya begins to suspect Anu's role

new_facts.fact: Anu records a voice note to Vikram exposing Arjun's invoice-padding demand and chai-stall cash threat
Vikram tells Anu she now works for his decisions, not just reports them
Vikram had already flagged Arjun's invoice three days before Anu's note; he orders a quiet finance audit before any HR action
Priya sees finance pull Arjun's invoices and questions Anu about what she told Vikram
